name: minimind
description: 🧠 两小时从 0 训出你的 64M 大模型。Train your own 64M LLM from scratch in 2 hours.
one_liner: A cheap, fast recipe for building your own tiny AI chatbot from absolute scratch, mostly so you can understand how one works under the hood.
buyer: A coding bootcamp or corporate AI-literacy trainer who needs a hands-on exercise that actually trains a real model instead of just calling an API.
business_use_cases: A bootcamp sells a one-day 'build your own LLM' workshop built directly on this repo as the lab exercise.
A YouTuber or course creator films a 'train an AI in 2 hours for $3' tutorial series that funnels into a paid, deeper AI engineering course.
A university teaching assistant uses it as the core assignment for an intro machine-learning class, saving weeks of curriculum-building time.

money_ideas.idea: Paid workshop or cohort course built around the repo's training recipe
A YouTube series monetized via ads/sponsorship that funnels into a paid advanced course

steal_this: Record yourself training the model this weekend, publish the video with honest numbers on cost and time, and use it as free marketing for a paid 'AI from scratch' course.
